name: Jarvis Beta
changes_cs: Jarvis v0.9.15 beta: WDUi vertex a pixel HLSL shadery se predem kompiluji pres fxc.exe. Release gate pred MSI vyzaduje available=1, used_precompiled=1 a nenulovy warmup cas, takze runtime D3DCompile fallback nelze vydat. Lokalizacni pamet obsahuje doplnene UI preklady pro vsech 78 podporovanych jazyku. Beta je zamerne nepodepsana; rucni instalacni QA neni v tomto vydani zaznamenana.
changes_en: Jarvis v0.9.15 beta: WDUi vertex and pixel HLSL shaders are precompiled with fxc.exe. The release gate requires available=1, used_precompiled=1, and a positive warmup duration before MSI creation, so a runtime D3DCompile fallback cannot ship. Localization memory now contains UI translations for all 78 supported languages. This beta is intentionally unsigned; manual installation QA is not recorded for this release.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis beta 0.9.14 sjednocuje dosavadni beta kod do kanonickeho main, zachovava Project Intake s confidence a cilene opravou tvrzeni a pridava odolnejsi WDUi accessibility, high-contrast vykreslovani a izolaci UI testu.
history.changes_en: Jarvis beta 0.9.14 consolidates the existing beta code into canonical main, preserves Project Intake confidence and targeted claim repair, and adds more resilient WDUi accessibility, high-contrast rendering, and isolated UI testing.

history.changes_cs: Verejna beta pro UI/UX testovani: souvisly TabView pro soubory projektu, GitHub a nahled souboru, oprava prekresleni nahledu po otevreni souboru a odolnejsi Project Intake cache.
history.changes_en: Public UI/UX beta: a continuous TabView for project files, GitHub and file preview, a file-preview repaint fix after opening a file, and more resilient Project Intake caching.
